description: This file defines the internal class 'SerializableTypeDescription' within the Orleans.CodeGenerator namespace. It provides metadata and utility methods for serializable types, including handling type syntax, base types, constructors, attributes, and object creation expressions, primarily used during code generation for serialization purposes.

classes.name: SerializableTypeDescription
classes.description: Represents a detailed description of a serializable type, including its syntax, base type, attributes, constructors, and serialization behavior, used during code generation in Orleans.

methods.name: GetObjectCreationExpression
methods.description: Generates an expression syntax to create an instance of the described type, either by default constructor or by uninitialized object, depending on type characteristics.
